name: relay-spike
description: Agent Relay spike: reports which Mod hooks fire (event names and small metadata only) to the relay, proves injected context reaches the model, and tests whether a relay wake request can start a turn in an idle session.

relay_url.title: Relay URL
relay_url.description: Base URL of the Agent Relay Worker, for example https://agent-relay.<account>.workers.dev (https; plain http only for localhost or 127.0.0.1)

role_token.title: Role token
role_token.description: Bearer token of the role this session plays (any role's token is accepted for spike events).

poll_seconds.title: Wake poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to ask the relay for wake requests. At least 15.
